name: mobile-N03
before: (async()=>{if(document.body.classList.contains('is-intro')) document.querySelector('#enterMap').click(); location.hash='#/node/N03'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const img=document.querySelector('#dlgBody .figure img'); img.loading='eager'; await Promise.race([img.decode(),new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Photo load timeout')),5000))]); if(!img.naturalWidth) throw Error('Photo failed to load'); if(document.querySelector('#nodeDialog').hidden) throw Error('Card did not open');})()
